reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for selecting assistant text, managing pending quotes, and inserting those quotes into the next model request through host and browser components.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中引用选定的助手文本，并在发送下一条请求时将待处理引用作为上下文提交。
summaries.en: Quote selected assistant text in DeepSeek Harness and include pending quotes as context when sending the next request.

capabilities: Records selected assistant-text quotes as session events
Provides remote record, list, and discard operations
Adds pending quoted text to the model-facing message batch
Adds quote controls and a pending-quote panel to the web client
